title: skills: the security rules do not teach a position's `renamedFrom` (a renamed position carries its holders) — PR #33008's Skills-docs follow-up
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1T5HEokjRgR6vCBX8

Filing gate: ① published skill text that omits a key an in-flight PR adds, owed by PR #33008's `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line; the seat files the card and rewrites that line to this number. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the lane and grade.
Reader: `domain:skills` (`skills/**`, shipped with `npx skills add`).
Blocked-by: #33008
Dedupe: `is:issue renamedFrom position skills` → 0 hits besides #32983 / #33008.
reach: named producer — the published skill an authoring agent loads, `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md` (positions and what they grant, on `origin/main`).

## What changes after #33008
`PositionSchema` gains `renamedFrom` (optional array of earlier position names, position-name grammar). When a package renames a position and declares the old name there, the security plugin moves that position's holders (`sys_user_position.position` old → new) in every organization at the next boot, as the system, idempotently. Refused: an old name that is still a position (any installed package, disabled included, or the environment), a cycle, two positions claiming one old name, a claim on a name the activation ledger records under another package or the environment, and a disabled claimant. Only holders move: sharing-rule / queue / record-share recipients, pending approvers, invitations and Setup-authored bodies naming the old name are reported at boot, not rewritten (ruling A1 on #32983).

## Do
In `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md`, teach that renaming a position means declaring `renamedFrom: ['old_name']` on the renamed position (never deleting and re-adding), what it carries (holders only, at boot) and what it leaves for the admin (the boot report's list). Changeset `'@objectstack/skills': patch`.

Related: #32983, #33008.
